title: Henry Wheeler's Barn
content: Henry Wheeler’s barn has a horse weathervane. The electrical line goes to a small electric milker.I've sat in the hayloft on a summer day. It's peaceful and quiet up there with a bright sunbeam slanting in the hayloft door.One of the sheds has old wagons and carriages parked inside it, almost as if they're ready to return to the roads again in case those newfangled automobiles give up the ghost.
